approvalState.description: Server/human approval state (open vocabulary, e.g. unsubmitted, pending-review, approved, rejected, superseded) — the client never decides approval.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

epistemicState.description: The canonical OBSERVED/INFERRED/CONFIRMED/PROPOSED distinction. An intervention scenario is PROPOSED until supported by post-execution evidence — the client never upgrades it.

scenarioId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.

version.description: Version of the intervention scenario (proposal states are versioned and reproducible from their inputs).
